title: Han Lie Causes Trouble
next_chapter_hook: As Han Lie was pressed to the ground by the demonic flames, the words squeezed from his throat exploded like thunder——"If you unite, this world will be destroyed!" Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply, the golden light of the Tianji Record trembling violently, as if confirming something.

text.content: The golden light swallowed Chen Ji whole, as if he stood within the river of time, the脉络 of the ten-thousand-year chess game slowly unfolding before his eyes. However, just at this moment, a furious roar tore through this tranquility——"Chen Ji! Get out here!" Chen Ji's gaze slightly hardened, the calm expression on his face finally cracking. Following the sound, at the entrance to the Kunlun Peak, a figure浑身浴火 was shattering layers of clouds and mist,气势汹汹地 pressing toward this side.

dialogue.content: Han Lie's body surged with flames, his eyes crimson red like blood, his chest heaving violently, clearly having rushed here at full speed. In his hand he gripped a war halberd glowing completely crimson red, the fire patterns on the halberd's body蠕动 like living creatures, emanating scalding waves of heat. "You trash, dare to secretly collude with the Demonic Path behind my back!" His voice trembled slightly from fury, the halberd tip pointing directly at Chen Ji, "Today I want to see who can still protect you!"

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, allowing the golden light to flow around his body, his expression淡漠 as if what stood before him was not the number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect, but a noisy mosquito. He slowly withdrew his palm pressed against the Tianji Record, the corner of his lips hooking into a meaningful arc: "Young Master Han tracked me all the way here, surely耗费了不少功夫. Only, this Kunlun Peak doesn't seem to be a place you should come." His tone was calm, even带着几分慵懒, yet every word cut to the heart.

dialogue.content: Upon hearing this, Han Lie grew even more furious, veins bulging on his forehead, his face contorted almost horrifically: "Stop your pretense with me!" He猛地踏前一步, the rocks beneath his feet actually showed signs of melting under the high temperature, "You think climbing the Demonic Path's ladder can change your fortunes? Let me tell you, before Han Lie, you'll always be that废物 not even worthy of carrying my shoes!" With that, he actually ignored Chen Ji, his gaze sweeping toward the Demonic Path commander beside him, killing intent fully exposed, "And you, Demonic Path remnant, today I shall eliminate you both!"

text.content: A cold gleam flashed through the depths of Chen Ji's eyes, yet his heart remained as clear as a mirror—Han Lie, though appearing reckless, had actually been tracking his movements all along. Today's rash intrusion onto Kunlun Peak was certainly not merely for venting anger. He vaguely guessed there was likely some hidden reason behind this, but at present it was not the time for deeper investigation. He turned to look at the Demonic Path commander, expression平静: "Commander, it seems our conversation today must be postponed." There was not a trace of panic in his tone, as if everything was under control.

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path commander stood above the clouds, his玄黑长袍 rustling in the wind, the demonic energy around him as deep and unfathomable as a bottomless abyss. Faced with Han Lie's provocation, he didn't even lift an eyelid, merely speaking casually: "Noisy." Just these two characters, yet they seemed to carry the威能 of suppressing heaven and earth, an invisible pressure suddenly descending. Han Lie's form jolted abruptly, his face instantly flushing red, his feet actually involuntarily retreating half a step. His pupils dilated sharply, looking at that玄黑身影 in disbelief, a压抑闷哼 escaping his throat.

text.content: Han Lie's face turned ashen, his fists clenched tightly, his knuckles white from exertion. He never imagined this seemingly unremarkable Demonic Path commander would possess such terrifying strength. But after all, he was the number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect—how could he be intimidated by mere words? He let out a furious roar, the true qi within his body surging violently, the flames on the crimson war halberd suddenly blazing ten zhang higher, transforming into a ferocious fire dragon that howled toward the Demonic Path commander. "A mere Demonic Path remnant, daring to play tricks before me!"

choice.prompt: Han Lie attacked ferociously, Chen Ji faced a choice: watch this闹剧 coldly, or intervene?

choices.description: Observe calmly, gauge the Demonic Path commander's true strength, while also observing Han Lie's real purpose for coming.
choices.visible_reward: Gain more intelligence, preserve trump cards
choices.risk_hint: May be seen as默认 standing on the Demonic Path's side

text.content: Chen Ji took a slight step backward, leaning against an ancient pine nearby, assuming a posture of unconcern. Yet his divine sense quietly spread like fine threads, taking in every movement on the battlefield. Such从容淡定 only made Han Lie increasingly furious—in his view, Chen Ji was clearly despising him.

Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his expression淡漠 as usual, only a gleam of sharpness flickering in the depths of his eyes. He thought to himself: Han Lie's timing in tracking him here was too precise, clearly someone had leaked his whereabouts. This debt, temporarily noted. His gaze swept over, noticing the playing smile at the corner of the Demonic Path commander's lips, alarm bells ringing in his heart—this person was绝非善类.

choices.description: Han Lie may be a sworn enemy, but rashly starting a war with the Demonic Path would only disrupt my plans—I must intervene.
choices.visible_cost: May expose relationship with the Demonic Path
choices.visible_reward: Seize dialogue initiative, further control the situation
choices.risk_hint: May cause Demonic Path commander dissatisfaction

text.content: Chen Ji stepped forward, his voice not loud yet clearly传入每个人耳中: "Young Master Han, please wait." He paused slightly, the corner of his lips hooking into a smile that was neither quite a smile: "This person is the Demonic Path commander. If you kill him, the three major sects and Demonic Path will wage full-scale war—can you bear this black pot? Or could it be... those people behind you are waiting for just such an excuse?"

The fire dragon roared forward, carrying the might to焚天煮海 as it lunged toward the Demonic Path commander. Yet that玄黑figure remained motionless until the fire dragon was less than three feet away, only then did he slowly raise his right hand. In an instant, the boundless demonic energy transformed into a手掌遮天巨掌, casually sweeping down toward that fire dragon. With a rumbling boom, the fire dragon was shattered like paper, scattered sparks flying in all directions, the scalding气息 sweeping across the entire Kunlun Peak. Han Lie's form shuddered violently, blood spurting from his mouth, his entire body sent flying backward like a断线风筝.

dialogue.content: Han Lie crashed heavily to the ground, plowing a deep groove dozens of zhang long on the rocky surface. He struggled to rise but found his limbs weak and无力, his meridians seemingly locked by some force, unable to调动 true qi at all. He wide-eyed, glaring死死 at that玄黑figure, a beast-like低吼 escaping his throat: "Impossible... who are you!" The voice carried几分惊恐, his earlier arrogance completely gone.

text.content: The Demonic Path commander stood with hands behind his back, his玄黑长袍 rustling in the wind,居高临下地 looking down at the狼狈 Han Lie, a淡漠 smile playing at his lips: "Who I am, you're not qualified to know." He slightly tilted his head, his gaze sweeping to Chen Ji,似笑非笑, "As for you, little friend, those words just now were rather interesting." He paused, withdrawing his gaze to look at the prostrate Han Lie, "Very well, keeping you alive is of no consequence. Only, since certain words have been spoken, a price must be paid."

dialogue.content: Han Lie's face turned pale as paper, cold sweat dripping down his forehead. In that previous palm strike, he clearly felt the气息 of death—if the other hadn't held back, he would have already been reduced to ashes. Yet his gaze still死死盯着 Chen Ji, the hatred in his eyes not only undiminished but growing fiercer. Finally, as if having made some decision, he gritted his teeth and低吼: "Chen Ji! You think climbing the Demonic Path gives you free rein? Let me tell you—if you truly unite, this world will be destroyed!" His voice hoarse, yet each word如雷.

text.content: Upon these words, the air atop Kunlun Peak seemed to凝固. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, the golden light of the Tianji Record trembling violently within him, as if confirming something. He下意识地 touched his chest, where the Tianji Record Fragment was emanating an unprecedented躁动. He thought to himself: Han Lie is merely a brute—how does he know about the Tianji Record unity? Unless... someone deliberately disclosed this to him. His gaze flickered, his eyes toward Han Lie gaining几分审视.

choice.prompt: Han Lie shouted a shocking secret, Chen Ji must respond:

choices.description: Vehemently deny any unity plan with the Demonic Path, counter-accuse Han Lie of spreading rumors.

choices.visible_reward: Maintain a clean identity before everyone

text.content: Chen Ji let out a light laugh, the smile carrying几分讥诮与不屑. He paced toward Han Lie,居高临下地 looking down at this狼狈不堪 Xuanwu genius, his voice clear: "Young Master Han, we are fellow sect disciples. I respected you as the Xuanwu Sect's number one genius, never expected you to be如此不堪. Defeated in one move and fly into a rage, fabricating such荒谬绝伦 lies to slander me?" He slightly shook his head,一副失望至极的模样, "Truly让人齿冷."

choices.description: Neither confirm nor deny, take the opportunity to question where Han Lie heard this news, trace the source to find the leak.
choices.visible_cost: Expose your own concern about this matter
choices.visible_reward: May uncover the mastermind behind the scenes
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path commander may develop suspicion of you

text.content: Chen Ji neither denied nor admitted, merely慢步走到 Han Lie's front, kneeling down, his gaze深幽如潭. The corner of his lips slightly lifted, revealing a meaningful smile: "Young Master Han's words are quite novel. I wonder where you heard such机密之事?" His voice was soft, yet seemed to carry some magic, making Han Lie involuntarily want to answer.

The Demonic Path commander watched this scene with饶有兴致, his玄黑面具下的双眸 flashing with playful light. He didn't interrupt, merely standing with hands behind his back, as if this闹剧 was merely an interesting消遣. Yet his gaze occasionally swept toward Chen Ji, carrying几分探究与审视, seemingly reassessing this seemingly废物杂役 disciple. The demonic energy in the air grew increasingly浓郁, giving an invisible pressure.

dialogue.content: Han Lie's lips trembled, seemingly struggling against some force. Yet Chen Ji's deep eyes seemed to possess some magic, making him不由自主地 want to confess. Finally, he hoarsely squeezed out several words: "It was... was the Old Sect Master... Ling Yuan told me... he said you have a Tianji Record Fragment, if united with the Demonic Path, it would awaken..." Before he finished speaking, he suddenly bit through his tongue, blood flowing down the corner of his mouth, his face full of痛苦与挣扎.

text.content: Ling Yuan! Chen Ji's heart jolted, yet his expression remained平静如水. The appearance of this name confirmed his long-held suspicion—that old sect master who superficially protected him had indeed been secretly watching, even going so far as to collaborate with fools like Han Lie. He slowly stood up, his gaze深邃如渊. The Tianji Record blazed with golden light within him, as if responding to something. He quietly murmured: "So that's how it is... Old Sect Master, you've finally shown yourfox's tail." His voice was soft, yet carried彻骨的寒意.

choice.prompt: After learning Ling Yuan was the mastermind, Chen Ji needed to decide his next move:

choices.description: Expose Ling Yuan's conspiracy publicly, turn Han Lie into his chess piece, reverse the situation.
choices.visible_reward: Plant seeds of doubt in Han Lie's heart, while demonstrating his value to the Demonic Path commander

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly burst into laughter, his voice echoing across Kunlun Peak, carrying几分畅快与讥诮. He turned to face the Demonic Path commander,朗声道: "Commander, did you hear that? Old Sect Master Ling Yuan sent this stupid dog to stir up trouble,还不忘给他递刀子." He paused, his gaze sharp as a blade, "It seems our negotiations must move to a different location." The Demonic Path commander微微颔首, a flash of appreciation in his eyes.

choices.description: Temporarily suppress this matter,不动声色, continue negotiations with the Demonic Path commander, keep Ling Yuan as a hidden chess piece for the future.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the chance to publicly humiliate
choices.visible_reward: Maintain controllable situation, not alert the enemy
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path commander may develop suspicions about you

text.content: Chen Ji收敛心神, his expression returning to that淡漠平静 demeanor. He didn't even glance at the prostrate Han Lie again, merely淡淡道: "Young Master Han's words, I have heard." He turned to face the Demonic Path commander, his expression unchanged, "Commander, you've seen the joke. Merely a跳梁小丑, nothing值得担忧. The conditions you mentioned earlier, I can agree to." His tone云淡风轻, as if nothing had happened.

Chen Ji stood atop Kunlun Peak, the狂风卷起 his garments, yet could not disturb the深沉寒意 in his eyes. Han Lie's existence was like a stone thrown into a lake—the ripples it created were far more profound than they appeared. He rapidly calculated in his heart: Since Ling Yuan dared to openly send someone to disrupt, it meant he no longer concealed his hostility toward me. And Han Lie's words about "unity destroying the world"—was it危言耸听, or was there truth to it? He下意识地 touched his chest, the Tianji Record Fragment remained scalding, as if responding to his doubts.

The Demonic Path commander慢步走到 Chen Ji's side, his玄黑长袍 forming a stark contrast with his杂役 garments. He lowered his gaze to look at this young杂役 disciple, a playful glint flickering in his eyes: "You certainly have composure." He raised a finger and pointed, a玄黑气流 entering Han Lie's body, completely sealing him. "This person I will take with me. Within three days, he will forget today's events." He looked at Chen Ji, "As for our cooperation... let us discuss another day." Before the话音落下, his form had already dissolved into漫天魔气, dispersing from Kunlun Peak.

As the demonic energy dissipated, Kunlun Peak returned to stillness. Chen Ji stood alone at the cliff's edge, gazing at the churning clouds below, his heart思绪万千. Han Lie's appearance had disrupted his original plan, yet also confirmed an important fact—Ling Yuan, was no longer able to wait. He slowly took out the Tianji Record Fragment, the golden light illuminating his平静面容,显得格外深邃. He quietly murmured: "Old Sect Master, the chess game between you and me has just begun." The cold wind howled past, blowing away his final smile, revealing the彻骨的冷意 beneath.

The golden light of the Tianji Record flowed through Chen Ji's palm, that familiar warmth now carrying几分躁动. He closed his eyes, his divine sense probing into the Fragment, only to see the originally blurry prophetic visions growing increasingly chaotic, as if some force was interfering with the Tianji Record's运作. He猛地opened his eyes, a flash of alarm掠过瞳孔—Chen Nian! Whenever he tried to foresee a future related to his sister, the visions became fragmented. And Han Lie's words just now about "unity destroying the world"—could it be related to her? He clenched his fists, his knuckles white. This mystery must be solved.

The wind atop Kunlun Peak grew increasingly凛冽, yet Chen Ji was oblivious. He stood at the cliff's edge, his gaze穿透层层云雾, as if seeing his sister somewhere in the Holy Sect, as if seeing those eyes that had always been watching him from deep within the Tianqing Sect. Ling Yuan, Chen Nian, Tianji Record, Demonic Path Commander—these seemingly unrelated names now intertwined into a vast net, and he himself stood at the net's center. He took a deep breath, storing the Tianji Record in his chest, and turned to descend Kunlun Peak. The final chapter of the ten-thousand-year chess game was just beginning to unfold, and he, Chen Ji, would surely place each piece,扭转乾坤.
